Bird flu
Bird Flu can spread quickly and may cause serious illness and death in wild birds, poultry and some other animals. If you see dead or dying birds – don’t touch and keep your pets away.
Learn more about Bird Flu

What’s on this week?
Saturdays 10.30–11.30am
Toddler time

At Paraparaumu Library – Join us for a fun and relaxed toddler hangout with stories, songs, and free play.

Saturdays 11.00am–12.00pm
Reading to dogs

With Gryphon – Join us at Paraparaumu library, settle in with a good book and a very good listener.

Saturdays and Sundays
SPLASH!

At Ōtaki and Coastlands pool – 1pm–4.30pm. Inflatable fun for the whole family!

Sundays, 8am–10am
Low Sensory Session

At Coastlands Aquatic Centre –enjoy low sensory and low noise in our deliciously warm programmes pool. 

Tue 4 Aug 9.30am–11.00am
Committee meeting

At Council Chambers – Strategy and Policy Committee meeting

Tue 4 Aug 11am–12.30pm
Council meeting

At Council Chambers – See our Meetings and agendas page for the agenda and livestream link

Tue 4 Aug 1.30pm–2.30pm
Council briefing

At Council Chambers – 3 Waters IBU plan and progress to date

Tue 4 Aug 7–9pm
Community Board meeting

Raumati Community Board meeting at Puoro 1, Te Raukura ki Kāpiti, 34A Raumati Road, Raumati Beach. See agenda.
